summary: The legal string contains at most 100 characters, which is too little scaling range for stable runtime separation between a single scan and plausible slower counting strategies.

workload_bound.source_constraint: s has length from 1 through 100 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation examines each character exactly once, performs constant work for its classification, and therefore makes at most 100 character examinations.

Regression compares the accepted adapter with an independent ASCII-classification oracle on 19,530 exhaustive representative strings, 5,000 deterministic strings spanning every legal length, explicit maximum-length boundaries, and every authored case.
